process: Approved review art and official reference -> three pose sheet -> transparent PNG. Source files copied unchanged; no local raster editing or compression.
whiteBackgroundStep: Replace the checkerboard background with a solid white background. Preserve the three characters, their positions, poses and image dimensions.
alphaStep: Remove the white background. Output a transparent background PNG with real alpha channel. Preserve the three characters unchanged. No checkerboard or white backdrop. Keep same positions, poses and image dimensions.
notes: The color/species in the alpha instruction was tailored to each character. Earlier checkerboard outputs were rejected; the final RGBA checks are in asset-qa.json.
recordType: Normalized prompt templates and process summary; not a complete verbatim log of failed attempts.
